act._note: Rate checked in the Finance Bill 2026 (as introduced), First Schedule Part II, company other than a domestic company: royalty and FTS both 20%. Forms 145/146 (FAQ 20-27) and Form 41 (user manual, section 159) checked on the Income Tax Department site. Compare with the enacted Finance Act 2026.

tds_trigger_quote: The Act governing TDS depends on when the "earlier of the event of credit or payment" occurs.

surcharge.source_quote: Every company, other than a domestic company. (i) Where the income or the aggregate of such incomes paid or likely to be paid and subject to the deduction exceeds ₹ 10000000 but does not exceed ₹ 100000000, at the rate of 2%
surcharge._note: Checked in the Finance Bill 2026 (as introduced), First Schedule Part II: foreign company 2%/5%; individuals and other non-company non-residents 10/15/25/37% on income other than dividends and capital gains; cess 4% on tax plus surcharge. Not modelled: non-resident firms (12% above Rs 1 crore), co-operatives, AOPs of companies. The slab test is on the year's aggregate paid or likely to be paid, not one payment. Applied only when the Act rate is used.

treaty_rate_is_final._note: Practitioner position (ITAT line of cases): a treaty rate is not loaded with surcharge and cess. Treated as a rule but flagged.

no_pan.nr_carve_out: Higher rate not applied to a non-resident who furnishes name, email, address, TRC and foreign TIN (Rule 37BC under the 1961 Act; successor rule under the 2025 Act not verified).
